title: GRAYFALL stage 1 with 3 players, from the intro to the first boss
author: Final_Huckleberry408
selftext:
Another update. This is the whole first stage now, cut down to 79 sec: story intro, street, the tavern, then GORGO at the gate.



Same disclaimer as before, the 3 players are my recording bots. They got a bit better since the last clip. They stopped swinging at air after the enemy is already gone, and the third one flanks now instead of standing on top of the others. Still dumb against GORGO though, they bunch up and just stand around while enemies get up.



Where does it stop looking like real players to you?

comments.author: Final_Huckleberry408
